1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.StarCutSegments
2 
3 /-! The developed star boundary is exactly a finite union of explicit
4 closed straight segments. Degenerate segments retain all source copies. -/
5 
6 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
7 
8 open Set
9 
10 namespace CutTreeCharts
11 
12 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a : frontier P.body} {T : P.CutLocusTree a} (charts : CutTreeCharts T)
13 
14 /-- Collect the cut sides in the single global placement. -/
15 noncomputable def boundarySegments : Finset (Plane × Plane) := by
16   classical
17   letI : Fintype T.vertices := T.finite_vertices.fintype
18   letI : DecidableRel T.graph.Adj := Classical.decRel _
19   exact Finset.univ.biUnion (fun d : T.graph.Dart =>
20     Finset.univ.biUnion (fun side : Bool => (charts.global d.adj).cutSegments side))
21 
22 theorem mem_boundarySegments (e : Plane × Plane) :
23     e ∈ charts.boundarySegments ↔ ∃ d : T.graph.Dart, ∃ side : Bool,
24       e ∈ (charts.global d.adj).cutSegments side := by
25   classical
26   simp [boundarySegments, or_comm]
27 
28 end CutTreeCharts
29 
30 namespace SixVertexGraph
31 
32 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
33   (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
34     (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
35 
36 include graph small_faces
37 
38 /-- Every listed segment is a cut copy, and every cut copy is on a listed segment. -/
39 theorem cutBoundaryImage_eq_segments {a : frontier P.body} {T : P.CutLocusTree a}
40     (charts : CutTreeCharts T)
41     (cofacial : ∀ v : P.Vertex, ∃ F : P.Face, (a : Space) ∈ F.val ∧ (v : Space) ∈ F.val) :
42     charts.cutBoundaryImage = ⋃ e ∈ charts.boundarySegments, segment ℝ e.1 e.2 := by
43   ext x
44   constructor
45   · rintro ⟨d, b, cut, placed⟩
46     obtain ⟨s, side, t, at_b, value⟩ := ((charts.global d.adj).places_iff_ray b x).mp placed
47     obtain ⟨e, listed, on_segment⟩ := (graph.triangle_cut_image small_faces (charts.global d.adj)
48       cofacial side x).mp ⟨s, t, at_b.symm ▸ cut, value⟩
49     exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨e, mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨(charts.mem_boundarySegments e).mpr ⟨d, side, listed⟩, on_segment⟩⟩
50   · intro member
51     obtain ⟨e, member⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp member
52     obtain ⟨listed, on_segment⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp member
53     obtain ⟨d, side, listed⟩ := (charts.mem_boundarySegments e).mp listed
54     obtain ⟨s, t, cut, value⟩ := (graph.triangle_cut_image small_faces (charts.global d.adj)
55       cofacial side x).mpr ⟨e, listed, on_segment⟩
56     exact ⟨d, (charts.global d.adj).routes side s t, cut,
57       ((charts.global d.adj).places_iff_ray _ _).mpr ⟨s, side, t, rfl, value⟩⟩
58 
59 /-- The entire boundary is a finite union of whole straight cut segments. -/
60 theorem develop_frontier_eq_segments {a : frontier P.body} {T : P.CutLocusTree a}
61     (charts : CutTreeCharts T) (source : Fin 6) (at_source : (a : Space) = (graph.vertex source : Space))
62     (cofacial : ∀ v : P.Vertex, ∃ F : P.Face, (a : Space) ∈ F.val ∧ (v : Space) ∈ F.val) :
63     frontier (range (fun c : P.UncutSurface a => charts.develop c.val)) =
64       ⋃ e ∈ charts.boundarySegments, segment ℝ e.1 e.2 := by
65   rw [graph.develop_frontier_eq_cutBoundaryImage small_faces charts source at_source cofacial,
66     graph.cutBoundaryImage_eq_segments small_faces charts cofacial]
67 
68 end SixVertexGraph
69 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
